answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fake identities. Each identity files work, like a velvet check, a marble quarry report, or a pigment test, and each epoch 5 random peers re-check one filing: auditors stake 20 coins, lost on a false pass, and a failed filing forfeits a 100-coin deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 coins, far above the diluted reward they could split, while an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps undiluted rewards.
